uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

4279-6112-6578--216.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6112-6578--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

391-2645-3430-5873.easyPrerequisites: Blossom Dryad doesn't have summoning sickness.
391-2645-3430-5873.description:
Activate Everglades by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Everglades
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3641-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3641-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1981-2415-3641-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2738-4871-5256-6248.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Phenomenon Investigators, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2034-3197-6854--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

1494-2230-4153-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six other cards in your graveyard.
1494-2230-4153-5256.description:
Cast Polukranos Unchained from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {4}{B}{G} and exiling six other cards from your graveyard, causing it to enter the battlefield with twelve +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Polukranos Unchained.
When Polukranos Unchained dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting twelve +1/+1 counters onto Sage of Hours.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Polukranos Unchained's power.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least two extra turns after this one.
Repeat every second extra turn until you run out of cards to pay the escape cost.

5016-6831.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Spitemare indestructible after it enters.
You have a way to deal damage to Spitemare after it enters.
5016-6831.description:
Cast Spitemare by paying its mana cost.
Give Spitemare indestructible.
Deal damage to Spitemare.
Spitemare triggers, dealing double that much damage to itself due to Neriv.
Repeat step 4 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the final Spitemare trigger, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to any target.
5016-6831.notes: If the source that is dealing damage to Spitemare is repeatable (such as Pyrohemia), you can deal damage to Spitemare again and redirect the damage elsewhere.

3179-3188-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Social Climber trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-3188-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-5241-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-5241-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Auton Soldier and Sakashima's Student each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-5241-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2324-2469-5220-6900.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 12 life
Repeat.

546-3192-4499-4613.easyPrerequisites: The number of red creatures you control excluding Ulasht plus the number of green creatures you control excluding Ulasht is at least 5.
546-3192-4499-4613.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Ulasht. Ulasht enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Ulasht using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1018-2104-7631.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Skullwinder
When the Skullwinder token enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5570-5708-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
5570-5708-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Nardole.
Nardole dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Vein Ripper
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Nardole trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Nardole, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

147-2921-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-2921-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {3}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1086-3490-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1086-3490-5231-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5223-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5223-7357.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

1824-2530-3497-7359.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-3497-7359.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
1824-2530-3497-7359.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Tablet of the Guilds triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

856-3967-5270.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Samwise triggers.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food token.
Repeat.

149-1424-4831.description:
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting Cacophodon.
Activate Cacophodon by tapping it.
Cacophodon triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to itself.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Cacophodon ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

1719-4613-5251.easyPrerequisites:
Emmara has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Emmara, Soul of the Accord does not have summoning sickness.
1719-4613-5251.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1719-4613-5251.description:
Activate a creature using Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability by tapping it, untapping Emmara.
Activate Emmara using Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability by tapping it.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Emmara ability from step 2, untapping another creature.
Repeat.

1140-1636-3143-6178.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1140-1636-3143-6178.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Zektar Shrine Expedition trigger.
Resolve the Zektar Shrine Expedition trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1336-2645.notablePrerequisites: Heronblade Elite does not have summoning sickness, and has power 5 or greater.
1336-2645.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
1336-2645.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1920-2060-3062-4222-5328.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Attentive Sunscribe.
1920-2060-3062-4222-5328.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Repeat.

1525-1636-3703-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
1525-1636-3703-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Sporemound triggers for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the first Sporemound trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 3 for any remaining trigger(s), if needed.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-3305-4812-5237.notablePrerequisites: Animate Dead attached to Body Launderer.
2034-3305-4812-5237.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Renegade Rallier, adding {C}{C}.
Renegade Rallier dies, triggering Body Launderer's first ability, causing it to connive.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Body Launderer, adding {C}{C}.
Body Launderer dies, triggering its second ability, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Renegade Rallier enters the battlefield, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Repeat.

717-1445-2366.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
717-1445-2366.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor, targeting any creature card in your graveyard.
Bone Miser triggers twice, adding {B}{B} and creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning any creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding any creature card, targeting Dryad Arbor.
Bone Miser triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

943-1556-4235.description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Scorched Ruins.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Deserted Temple.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping Deserted Temple and Scorched Ruins.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Once you have a large amount of {C}, you may untap any other lands you control in place of Scorched Ruins.
